# tebib_load_balancer_listener (Resource)

A port a load balancer accepts traffic on, and the target group it forwards to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_load_balancer_listener" "api" {
  load_balancer_id = tebib_load_balancer.web.id
  port             = 8443
  target_group_id  = tebib_load_balancer_target_group.api.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load balancer ID (`lb-...`). Changing it replaces the listener.
- `port` (Number) Port (1-65535), one listener per port. Changing it replaces the listener.
- `target_group_id` (String) Target group to forward to (`lbtg-...`). Changes in place.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` (default) or `http`. Changing it replaces the listener. Its target group must use the same protocol.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Listener ID (`lbl-...`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <load_balancer_id>/<listener_id>, optionally with <project_id>/ in front.
terraform import tebib_load_balancer_listener.api lb-abc123/lbl-def456
```
